leaf.text:
This is a superset of leaf 0xb, with more topology levels and domain types. For Intel CPUs, always use this leaf if available. That is, if leaf 0's @max_std_leaf ≥ 0x1f.
For AMD CPUs, v2 topology enumeration is provided at leaf 0x80000026.

subleaf.text: Subleaf ID acts as the domain level specifier. Clients should keep iterating on all subleaves until hitting @domain_type = 0 (invalid).

bit0.desc: Bit width of this level (previous levels inclusive)
Logical CPUs count across all instances of this domain
bit0.text: The CPUs count is lower-domains inclusive.

bit0.desc: x2APIC ID of current logical CPU
bit0.text: The APIC ID is always valid and does not vary along with subleaf index.
